p=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d3581e67.py'); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    color = min((v for v in counts if v != max(counts, key=counts.get)), key=lambda v: -counts[v])
    bg = max((v for v in counts if v != color), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
    sh, sw = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == bg for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p, p.exists())
